data.one_liner: A Tinder-like swipeable card stack widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: TCard provides a widget stack that users can swipe left or right, commonly used for dating apps, flashcards, or content browsing interfaces. It includes a controller for programmatic navigation (back, forward, reset) and callbacks for tracking swipe direction and completion.
use_when: You need a Tinder-style card swiping interface in your app.
You want to display a stack of images, videos, or custom widgets that can be dismissed left or right.
avoid_when: You need a standard pagination or carousels without card swiping physics.
strengths: Easy to set up with standard widget lists or network images.
Includes a controller to programmatically trigger swipes and reset cards.
weaknesses: Limited to left/right card swiping paradigms.
Not documented for complex custom physics beyond basic parameters.
data.minimal_example:
List<Widget> cards = List.generate(5, (index) => Container(color: Colors.blue));
TCard(cards: cards);
